'''Imperial Recon Unit 42B8/S327''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] unit. The formation consisted of two [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]], including [[dd54639//322T]].
